sermon.title: Getting What You Want or What You Need
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: A short message on the difference between treating God as a wishing well and trusting the promises He actually made. God does not promise to heal everyone or help you score a goal, but in Acts 2:38 He promises everyone who repents and is baptized the removal of sin and the gift of the Holy Spirit.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: This is a short excerpt (about 3 minutes), not a full service. He cites “Acts 17” for God commanding all men everywhere to repent (Acts 17:30).

faqs.question: Where should our faith come from?
faqs.answer: From the source, the Scriptures; we don’t want to make up our own kind of faith.

faqs.question: What faith should we get away from?
faqs.answer: He says the faith that America is preaching; get back to the faith Abraham had.

faqs.question: How was Abraham’s faith counted?
faqs.answer: He points to Scripture on how Abraham’s faith was counted to him for righteousness.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

faqs.question: Does God answer a child’s prayer for a goal?
faqs.answer: Maybe He smiles and helps, he says, but that is not what He promised.

faqs.question: Will God get me out of trouble I caused?
faqs.answer: He says God doesn’t promise to break you out of jail when you commit crimes.

faqs.question: Were these Peter’s words or Christ’s?
faqs.answer: Spoken by Peter, but Peter was a disciple and apostle with Christ, and these are the things Jesus said.

faqs.question: Is the promise only for Christians?
faqs.answer: No; it is a promise to Muslims, Hindus, Buddhists and every person on the planet.

faqs.question: Who does God command to repent?

scriptures.text_nkjv: Truly, these times of ignorance God overlooked, but now commands all men everywhere to repent,

faqs.question: What does baptism identify us with?
faqs.answer: The death, burial and resurrection of Jesus Christ.
